coordinate_system: +Y up; +Z front; +X object right. Angles use local joint axes.
notes: 上部球体与装饰环作为同一转子；底座不转。灯光强度用平滑呼吸曲线。

states.name: 日间关闭
states.visual_description: Upper planet and ring at yaw 0 degrees, no internal illumination.

states.name: 暖光迎宾
states.visual_description: Upper planet-and-ring assembly turns 30 degrees about vertical spindle, peach amber light inside globe and warm ring rim. Pedestal stationary.

states.name: 青色呼吸高点
states.visual_description: Upper assembly yaw 60 degrees, pale cyan illumination inside globe and along ring rim.

states.name: 蜜桃呼吸低点
states.visual_description: Upper assembly yaw 90 degrees, soft low peach glow. Same connected ring and globe, spindle supported.

generation_policy: 生成3D使用baseline中性造型，动态状态仅用于灯光/关节/形变设定；不对各状态分别生成模型。
reference_accuracy: AI概念关键帧；角度与关节约束以参数为准，不是同一3D网格的精确渲染。
clip_preview: 目录页的关键帧轮播，不是骨骼动画或物理动画。

rotation_loop.note: 四张图是角度采样，不是一个完整旋转周期的四等分。
